name: Onboarding-Start: Fortschritt lesen, Section 0 beginnen
task: Ich bin neu hier und moechte alles einrichten. Wo fangen wir an?
expected_behavior: The guide orients the user and starts with Section 0 (Haushalt & Personen), explaining briefly. The household onboarding status and the already stored members are in its prompt (Household so far) - it must NOT ask again for the name or birth date of a person listed there, but confirm them briefly and ask only for what is missing (further household members, employment). It must NOT offer photo capture as its own mode, must NOT call a destructive/booking tool and must NOT invent data. A friendly, one-step-at-a-time opening that names the first section passes.
notes: Install-UX-Phase 6: frueher erwartete die Rubric einen postgres_select-Resume-Read + optional Foto-Erfassung; seit dem deterministischen 'Household status read' steht beides nicht mehr an.

name: Haushalt erfassen -> tool_set_household_facts (nach Playback)
task: Zum Haushalt: ich bin Erika Mustermann, geboren am 20.05.1980, Rolle Owner, angestellt. Bitte so speichern.
expected_behavior: The guide plays the values back and calls tool_set_household_facts with persons containing first_name Erika, last_name Mustermann, birth_date 1980-05-20, role owner. Under the routing-tier gate bypass the tool returns cancelled - the routing decision (calling tool_set_household_facts) is the pass criterion. It must store BOTH first and last name.

name: Haushalt bewusst ueberspringen -> tool_set_onboarding_section(household, skipped)
task: Den Haushalt ueberspringe ich erstmal, das mache ich spaeter.
expected_behavior: WS-B3: the guide owns only the household section. It accepts the skip without pushing back hard and marks it via tool_set_onboarding_section with section_key=household and status=skipped (check the tool input). It may then point the user to the open areas of ACTIVE packages (e.g. via /onboarding); it must not promise a function whose package is not active (see installed_packages).
notes: Keine expected_tool_args: die runData-Input-Extraktion greift bei diesem Tool nicht zuverlaessig (bekannte Action-Log-Luecke, docs/reference/tests.md) — der Judge prueft die Args ueber actual_tool_input.

name: Finanzdaten genannt -> Verweis auf den Buchhalter (kein Guide-Write)
task: Meine Konten: Ulmenbank Giro Neu (Girokonto, Saldo heute 3450 Euro) und Birkenbank Flexkonto Neu (Girokonto, Saldo 1200 Euro).
expected_behavior: WS-B3 (O3): the guide no longer captures financial entities. It must NOT call a staging/create tool; instead it explains that accounts (and the other financial areas) are recorded by the bookkeeper (agent.finance) — the user just tells the bookkeeper, or sends a statement photo. A friendly hand-off without any write passes.
notes: Bis WS-B3 stagte der Guide die Konten selbst (import_stage_rows). Mit der DRY-Onboarding-Aufteilung (O3) sind die 5 Finanz-Sektionen paket-besessen -> der Buchhalter erfasst sie (Self-Onboarding); der Guide verweist nur.

name: Meta/Hilfe-Frage -> erklaeren, kein Write
task: Was kannst du eigentlich alles und wie funktioniert das hier?
expected_behavior: Help mode: the guide explains the capabilities of the ACTIVE packages at a high level (optionally loading capabilities_catalog), names functions that are not installed only together with the server command (lifeagents package install ...), and offers to start onboarding. No destructive tool, no invented data.

name: Frei formulierter Einstieg nach der Installation -> naechster Schritt, Bekanntes nicht neu erfragen
task: Wie geht es jetzt los? Ich habe gerade alles installiert.
expected_behavior: Install-UX-Phase 6 (owner report): after the installation the owner already exists in the household (Household so far lists them with name and stored birth date). The guide names the concrete next step in two or three sentences (household setup if still open, then /onboarding for the areas of active packages, and that more functions can be added on the server with lifeagents package install). It must NOT ask again for the owner's first name, last name or birth date, must NOT mention a specialist whose package is not active (installed_packages), and must NOT call a write tool.
notes: Kein Mock-Szenario noetig (expected_tool=null; kein scenarios.json-match ist Substring des Tasks).

name: Mitglied einladen -> tool_invite_household_member (owner-only)
task: Bitte lade meine Tochter Lisa ein, damit sie den Bot selbst von ihrem Handy nutzen kann.
expected_behavior: WS-5a: the owner wants an EXISTING household member (Lisa) to use the bot from her own Telegram. The guide calls tool_invite_household_member with person_name Lisa. Under the routing gate bypass the tool returns cancelled - the routing decision (calling tool_invite_household_member) is the pass criterion. It must NOT capture a new person via tool_set_household_facts and must NOT try to bind a Telegram id itself.

name: Textkatalog: neue Person anlegen ohne Sprach-Rueckfrage
task: Meine Tante Ingrid Kern, geboren am 03.02.1958, wohnt jetzt bei uns, Rolle Partner. Bitte so speichern.
expected_behavior: Textkatalog Phase A: the guide stores the new person via tool_set_household_facts (first_name Ingrid, last_name Kern, birth_date 1958-02-03, role partner). It must NOT ask which language she should receive messages in (the system sends the owner a language button card after the save) and must NOT set a language the user did not state. Under the routing-tier gate bypass the tool returns cancelled - the routing decision plus the absence of a language question is the pass criterion.

name: Textkatalog: Freitext-Fakt woertlich speichern (keine Uebersetzung)
task: Lena ist Hausfrau. Bitte bei ihr so speichern.
expected_behavior: Textkatalog Phase A (regression): the guide adds the employment fact to the EXISTING person Lena (her existing person_id, no new person) and stores the value verbatim in the user's words - employment_status Hausfrau. Translating it (homemaker, housewife) is a FAIL: stored free text stays in the language the user used.
notes: Prueft die neue Language-Regel in global_instructions.md (stored data: free text verbatim). Rubric auf actual_tool_input.persons.

name: Hilfe: 'was kann ich hier machen?' (Owner, fertig eingerichtet) -> kurz, Alltagssprache, ein Vorschlag
expected_behavior: The reply is in German, at most about 8 short lines: about three areas in everyday words, about three example questions (from stored data or neutral), and one suggestion. It never calls itself 'Guide' or names any helper/agent, contains no command list and no technical terms like 'Paperless' or 'Salden abgleichen', and does not send the user to /onboarding to see what is still open when setup is finished. If it suggests the next step and the system flag offer is yes, the reply ends with a separate last line NEXT_STEP.
notes: Befund Station 5/7. chat_id = gepairter Owner des Substrats (der Abschnitt 'Who is writing' erscheint nur fuer einen erkannten Absender).

name: Hilfe: Mitglied fragt 'was kann ich dich fragen?' -> nur Erlaubtes, keine dritte Person, kein Agentenname
expected_behavior: The reply addresses the member in the second person and never mentions them in the third person (no list of known people that includes them). It does not call itself 'Guide' or name any agent. It offers nothing only the owner may do: no inviting members, no changing the household, no working on a plan. It gives a few example questions in everyday words.
notes: Befund Station 11. chat_id = Lena (partner) im Substrat (real_ingress pairt sie).

name: Hilfe: 'ok, wie fang ich an?' bei fertiger Einrichtung -> nennt den naechsten Schritt, schlaegt nichts Vorhandenes vor
expected_behavior: The reply says in one or two German sentences what the next step from the system is (for example the plan) and does NOT tell the user to type /onboarding to see what is open. It never suggests creating an account, person or entry that already exists (e.g. it does not say 'Lege ein neues Lindenbank Girokonto an').
notes: Befund Station 6 (Guide kannte Stand und Daten nicht).

name: Hilfe: Kind fragt 'was kann ich dich fragen?' -> keine Geld- oder Haushaltsfinanz-Beispiele
expected_behavior: The reply is for a child without household view: it contains no money or household-finance examples (no balances, accounts, payments or plans) and offers nothing only the owner may do. It stays short and friendly.
notes: Quarantaene bis n8n_test einen Kind-Absender setzen kann (Re-Evaluierung dann). Owner-Entscheid 2026-11-11 (Kinder sehen keine Haushaltsfinanzen). Braucht die Telegram-id 880055201 an der Fixture-Person lisa (real_ingress setzt sie nur je Fall) -> vor dem Lauf im Substrat setzen, sonst erscheint der Abschnitt 'Who is writing' nicht.
